🌌 SPACEI Community Rules

You only have to accept these once on this device/profile. Major rule updates may be shown again.
1. Be respectful. No bullying, harassment, threats, hate speech, or targeted abuse. 2. Protect personal information. Never post someone's address, phone number, email, school, passwords, or other private information. 3. Never share recovery codes. Create and safely store your SPACEI account recovery code. SPACEI staff will never ask for it. 4. No scams or manipulation. No phishing, blackmail, fake giveaways, impersonation, or pressuring people for personal information. 5. Trusted Friends still have boundaries. Trusted status never gives permission to share another person's private information. 6. No staff impersonation. Developer, Creator, Moderator, and official labels/badges may only be assigned by SPACEI. 7. Keep videos safe. No sexual content, graphic gore, dangerous challenges, harassment, scams, or exposing somebody's private information. 8. Messaging must stay safe. Users may block and report anyone. Trying to bypass a block or repeatedly harassing someone can lead to suspension. 9. Shop buying and selling is 16+. No weapons, drugs, alcohol/nicotine, stolen goods, counterfeit goods, sexual items, personal information, animals, or illegal/unsafe products. 10. Shop moderation is separate from shopping. Authorized moderators may review and remove listings even if they cannot buy or sell. 11. Do not expose addresses through the Shop. Public listings must not reveal home addresses, phone numbers, or personal emails. 12. Emergency features are for real emergencies only. 13. Pets stay all-ages. No sexual anatomy/customization or sexual interactions involving pets. 14. Follow the law and platform rules. 15. Breaking rules can lead to content removal, warnings, feature restrictions, suspension, or permanent bans.

Your full card details should be handled by a secure payment provider, not stored where SPACEI staff can read them.
🛡️ SPACEI Protection

💣 Anti-Nuke

Rate limits mass actions and can freeze suspicious delete/report/post bursts before they damage the local prototype.

🔐 Anti-Hack

Blocks dangerous script-like text in user content, limits repeated actions, and records suspicious events. Real account protection also requires the hosted backend.

🤝 Anti-Hate

Checks public posts/comments/shop text for targeted hateful or threatening content and holds suspicious content for moderation instead of publishing it automatically.

What works offline now
Basic chat, local game tools, simple writing/code helpers, local saved memory/settings, and offline UI features.
What needs the hosted AI backend
Real web search, image generation, strong file/image understanding, full model reasoning, cloud memory, voice AI, and other server-powered tools.
